title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Pink Lemonade Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit offers a sparkling twist on a citrus classic. Zesty Lemon makes for a bubbly, citrusy base, softened by sweet, subtle red berry notes to create that unmistakable Pink Lemonade character. Lightly tangy and slightly fizzy, it’s a bright, refreshing vape that’s easy to enjoy all day. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is designed for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. They connect magnetically and work with the twist-activated dual pod system for instant flavour pairing. With two pods in every pack, Pink Lemonade is an uplifting option that pairs especially well with fruit, ice, or mint-based flavours.
